newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Universal Rightfield creates leisure company.
newsitem.headline: Universal Rightfield creates leisure company.

text.p: Property concern Universal Rightfield Property Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it has created a wholly-owned leisure development unit called Universal Leisure Corp (ULC).

To have an authorised capital stock of one billion pesos, the new company's first project is a multiple resort development consisting of two city clubs, a mountain spa, golf resort, and an island beach resort.
This project is set for launching within the year, the company said in a statement.

Universal Rightfield also said ULC will have a 22 percent stake in Metro Tagaytay Land Company Inc, which is the owner of 1,003 hectares of land in Batulao Nature city, Batangas located south of Manila. Batulao Nature City is a resort-residential development.
